title: Learning and Development Specialist, E-Learning and LMS
description:
Learning and Development Specialist, E-Learning and LMS

Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

The Learning and Development Specialist will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and optimization of Xometry's e-learning content and Learning Management System (LMS). This role will play a critical part in ensuring a seamless and effective learning experience for all staff and customers through the support of onboarding, ongoing professional development, and external facing training. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of technical expertise in LMS administration, demonstrated development of e-learning content, and excellent communication and project management skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • E-learning Content Development: Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) and L&D team members to create, review, update, and ensure the accuracy of existing and new e-learning content. Assist in the testing and quality assurance of new e-learning courses and modules prior to deployment. Manage the content lifecycle, including version control, archiving, and retirement of outdated materials.
  • LMS Administration & Management: Serve as the primary administrator for the company's Learning Management System (Percipio). Manage user accounts, roles, and permissions; troubleshoot access issues. Upload, organize, and publish e-learning courses, modules, and learning paths. Create and manage learning assignments, notifications, and completion tracking. Monitor LMS performance, identify and resolve technical issues, and provide technical support to users. Stay up-to-date on LMS features and best practices, recommending and implementing improvements. Generate and analyze reports on learning activity, course completion, and program effectiveness.
  • Learning Program Support: Support the deployment of new learning initiatives and programs within the LMS and across the organization. Assist in the creation of engaging learning pathways and user-friendly navigation within the LMS. Provide support for virtual instructor-led training (VILT) sessions, including scheduling, platform setup, and participant management. Respond to employee inquiries regarding learning resources and LMS functionality.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with HR Business Partners, department leaders, and subject matter experts to understand learning needs. Communicate effectively with employees regarding new learning opportunities and LMS updates. Participate in special projects as assigned by the Head of L&D or HR Leadership.

Qualifications

  • This role requires working core aligned hours to US Eastern Time.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Education, Instructional Design, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Advanced English level.
  • 3+ years of experience in Learning & Development, with a strong focus on LMS administration and e-learning content management.
  • Proven experience as an administrator for LMS.
  • Strong understanding of e-learning standards
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace.
  • Excellent technical aptitude and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot LMS and e-learning issues effectively.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • A passion for learning and development and a commitment to employee growth.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, Captivate).
  • Familiarity with graphic design principles for e-learning content.
  • Experience in a high-growth technology or manufacturing company.

Please submit your resume in English.

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Overview

Job title: Marketing Manager and Graphic Designer - Amazon

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $ per month

About the Role

We’re seeking an Amazon Graphics Designer to craft premium, on-brand visuals that boost click-through and conversion for skincare products. You’ll transform product USPs and ingredient benefits into clean, conversion-oriented imagery across hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, and A+ content. This role is ideal for a designer who loves partnering with marketing, testing ideas, and pushing for the best creative outcomes.

About the Company

A growing beauty and skincare e-commerce brand focused on premium, science-informed products and exceptional customer experience on Amazon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing Amazon listing visuals (hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, A+ content) optimized for CTR and conversion
  • Translate skincare benefits, ingredients, and brand positioning into clear, premium visual narratives
  • Collaborate with marketing to align on USPs, target audiences, and creative direction; contribute thoughtful feedback and recommendations
  • Create infographics, lifestyle imagery, and visual instructions using provided photography and assets
  • Maintain strict adherence to Amazon image guidelines and evolving beauty / skincare creative trends
  • Organize files, templates, and versioning to support rapid testing and iteration

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing Amazon listing images (beauty / skincare preferred), with a strong portfolio of relevant work
  • Deep understanding of skincare and how to visually communicate ingredient benefits and product features
  • Advanced skills in typography, layout, and visual storytelling with meticulous attention to detail
  • Ability to turn raw product info into clean, conversion-focused visuals under tight deadlines
  • Experience with A+ Content and Amazon Storefront design
  • Comfortable collaborating, giving / receiving constructive feedback, and backing creative opinions with data and rationale
  • Tools: Adobe Photoshop; Google Sheets; familiarity with Amazon A+ Content modules and Seller tools
  • Advanced fluency in English is required (written and verbal)

Nice to Have Skills

  • Familiarity with packaging design and / or 3D mockup tools (e.g., Adobe Dimension, Blender)
  • Basic copywriting and understanding of marketing psychology for conversion-focused messaging
  • Experience leveraging ChatGPT to streamline creative workflows and project management
  • Knowledge of Adobe Illustrator or Figma for layout systems and component libraries
  • Photo retouching and light color-grading for skincare / lifestyle imagery

Why Join Us?

Work on beautiful, premium skincare brands where your creative decisions directly impact visibility and sales. Join a collaborative team that values thoughtful pushback, testing, and continuous learning—where you’re encouraged to teach, challenge assumptions, and help raise the bar on Amazon-first design.

How to Apply

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure the right fit for you and our team. Here’s what to expect :

  • Complete the application form (you’ll be sent the link after expressing interest)
  • Screening interview with our recruitment team

We’re looking forward to learning more about you!

description:
Analista Governança e Controle Pleno - VMO | Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura

Descrição da vaga

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro. Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo. Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões. Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. O Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) da Globo tem a missão de viabilizar e agregar valor às operações da empresa. Com uma grande diversidade de escopos e de colaboradores (são mais de 1.700), é natural que tenha um desafio de governança. Com um robusto orçamento de investimentos e despesas para prestar serviços internos e desenvolver projetos de conservação e modernização do parque de infraestrutura, a diretoria sensibiliza os direcionadores estratégicos da Globo de geração de valor econômico-financeiro e de compromissos ESG. Neste contexto, torna-se essencial um modelo de gestão robusto, com métricas, rotinas, padrões, reportes e captação do valor gerado pela aplicação de tantos recursos e processos. O VMO beneficia o CSC construindo uma visão estratégica da diretoria e garantindo uma governança de projetos madura, com metodologia, entregas transparentes, de qualidade e alinhadas com a Globo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Acompanha e reporta o desenvolvimento dos projetos de áreas clientes, verificando o cumprimento de cronogramas, orçamento, escopo e critérios de qualidade/valor.
  • Elabora, define e dissemina metodologias e ferramentas que apoiem o gerenciamento de projetos nas áreas e projetos estratégicos da diretoria, sempre alinhado com as últimas tendências.
  • Apoia a interface com outras áreas envolvidas nos projetos.
  • Analisa os indicadores de projetos, reportando os resultados na área.
  • Atua como gestor de projetos adHOC, estruturando um plano, antecipando riscos, formatando, acompanhando e reportando o desenvolvimento dos trabalhos e gerindo os impactos de forma a preservar os produtos combinados.
  • Levanta e elabora cenários para defesa do ciclo com contexto interno, externo e desafios.
  • Conduz e consolida defesa dos projetos dos departamentos para o diretor executivo.
  • Presta consultoria e suporte técnico às áreas no período de ciclo orçamentário, utilizando como base as melhores práticas e uso de ferramentas.
  • Consolida o orçamento de projetos dos departamentos e elabora apresentação para defesa do planejamento do CSC para os próximos anos.
  • Conduz e reporta o andamento dos OKRs estratégicos do CSC e táticos de Governança e Controle.
  • Conduz o processo de definição, acompanhamento e revisão de OKRs, alinhados à estratégia da organização.
  • Facilita workshops e reuniões de alinhamento com lideranças e pontos focais.
  • Analisa gaps, tendências e desvios, propondo e/ou cobrando planos de ação para correções de rumo.
  • Analisa, consolida, valida e divulga, periodicamente, indicadores e resultados por meio de relatórios gerenciais.
  • Identifica oportunidades de otimização operacional nas áreas, a fim de eliminar desperdícios.
  • Elabora conteúdos gerenciais, com visão executiva que facilitem a análise de informações para acompanhamento de resultados e tomada de decisão.
  • Realiza ações de comunicação e engajamento, acerca de assuntos que são transversais na área, a fim de garantir abrangência, uniformidade e alinhamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou correlatas.
  • Habilidade no pacote Microsoft 365, com destaque ao Excel (intermediário/avançado).
  • Produção de relatórios em Power BI (intermediário).
  • Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de projetos (métodos tradicionais ou ágeis) e OKR.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara e eficaz com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Visão analítica, ser interessado, proativo, organizado e com energia para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas ao mesmo tempo.
  • Gestão e melhoria contínua de processos (PDCA, DMAIC, ferramenta Bizagi).
  • Automação de processos. Ex: VBA no Excel, Power Automate no Microsoft 365.
  • Certificações como PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma ou similares.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com estrutura de VMO ou PMO.
  • Usuário de ferramenta de controle de projetos (PPM). Ex: ERP Oracle, Jira, Clarity PPM, Primavera.
  • Programação no Power BI.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio.

Informações adicionais

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Apoio técnico para os programas de financiamento verde e desenvolvimento produtivo role at Inter-American Development Bank. We improve lives.

O Grupo BID é uma comunidade de pessoas diversas, versáteis e apaixonadas, unidas para melhorar vidas na América Latina e no Caribe. Aqueles que trabalham conosco encontram propósito e fazem o que mais amam em um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo, ágil e gratificante.

About This Position

Estamos procurando um consultor técnico com experiência específica em finanças sustentáveis, conhecimento dos aspectos técnicos de finanças verdes e climáticas e instrumentos financeiros para apoiar o desenvolvimento de informações e gerenciamento de conteúdo e acompanhar as atividades de apoio que estão sendo executadas por meio de diferentes atividades de CMF. O consultor também será responsável por garantir que todas as informações de apoio, inclusive os relatórios de implementação e os materiais de conhecimento desenvolvidos, sejam mantidos nos sistemas de informação do BID, nos sistemas de informação dos clientes beneficiários e outras plataformas relevantes.

O Consultor trabalhará com a equipe da Divisão de Conectividade, Mercado e Finanças (CMF). Esta equipe é responsável por desempenha um papel vital no desenvolvimento dos mercados financeiros e do setor privado na América Latina e no Caribe. Nossa experiência inclui o apoio a bancos de desenvolvimento e a inclusão financeira através de bancos comerciais, promovendo práticas sustentáveis sociais, ambientais e de governança corporativa. Nossos projetos buscam promover finanças sustentáveis e o desenvolvimento produtivo das MPMEs, por meio de estratégias inovadoras de financiamento estruturado e da geração de conhecimento operacional para conceber, operacionalizar e executar medidas de políticas públicas para apoiar a produtividade econômica, ampliação dos investimentos de baixo carbono e resilientes do setor privado e capacitar os participantes do mercado financeiro e de capitais local para integrar as informações mais recentes relacionadas ao ESG e ao clima. Além disso, CMF coordena e apoiar a estruturação de estratégias inovadoras de financiamento verde, em particular no apoio à implementação de um portfólio de atividades que estão sendo executadas pelo BID em toda a região da América Latina e do Caribe.

What you’ll do

O consultor apoiará IFD/CMF nas seguintes ações, mas não se limitará a elas:

  • Apoiar tecnicamente as operações, incluindo operações voltadas às finanças verdes e o acesso do setor produtivo às atividades de financiamento de CMF, com orçamento, planejamento das atividades, análises técnicas e preparação de relatórios de progresso.
  • Revisar e comentar tecnicamente estudos e materiais de apoio desenvolvidos por outros consultores para avaliar a qualidade dos resultados antes da entrega, relacionados a ESG em sistemas financeiros, instrumentos financeiros verdes e sustentáveis, além de medidas para apoiar as MPMEs a enfrentar problemas de liquidez e de financiamento de meio e longo-prazo.
  • Preparar produtos de conhecimento relacionados ao desenvolvimento, implementação e avaliação de medidas para apoiar as micro, pequenas e médias empresas (MPMEs) a enfrentarem problemas de liquidez a curto prazo e viabilizar o financiamento produtivo para a recuperação econômica sustentável.
  • Apoiar, por meio de cooperação técnica, bancos de desenvolvimento nacionais e subnacionais e entidades públicas para mobilizar investimentos privados para projetos de infraestrutura de baixo carbono, auxiliando as DFIs brasileiras a testar instrumentos financeiros verdes inovadores e a estruturar mecanismos de redução de riscos relacionados ao clima.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de títulos e empréstimos verdes/sustentáveis com os clientes, fornecendo roteiros, avaliação de ativos elegíveis, alinhamentos com estratégias institucionais e desenvolvimento de estruturas alinhadas com os critérios estabelecidos pelo empréstimos e títulos verdes/sustentáveis.
  • Apoiar e coordenar o estabelecimento de parcerias para fomentar o diálogo entre os setores público e privado, a fim de compartilhar conhecimento e capacitação que possam alavancar instrumentos financeiros e de mercado de capitais verdes.
  • Apoiar na preparação de projetos/propostas para acessar Fundos Internacionais Verdes (por exemplo, GEF, CTF, CIF, GCF e NAMA) e outras fontes de financiamento independente e projetos do BID.
  • Apoiar a implementação de novos projetos e operações de CMF, fornecendo assistência técnica no desenvolvimento de soluções financeiras inovadoras, salvaguardas ESG e conformidade com finanças sustentáveis e orientação.
  • Coletar dados e desenvolver conteúdo de conhecimento e consultoria, notas de discussão e materiais informativos para uso interno do BID e clientes.
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de treinamento e organização de diálogos de eventos, preparando apresentações e agendas preliminares, relatórios preliminares e documentos de base.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o acompanhamento de cooperações técnicas vinculadas a empréstimos, seus termos de referência e contratações.
  • Apoiar as atividades do IFD/CMF conforme necessário e solicitado pelo Supervisor.

What you’ll need

  • Educação: Mestrado em Administração, Economia, Finanças, Ciências Ambientais, Engenharia
  • Experiência: pelo menos 10 anos de experiência profissional relevante em finanças verdes e climáticas, mercados financeiros e de capitais e gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Línguas: Capacidade de ler, escrever e falar português, espanhol e inglês.

Requirements

  • Cidadania: Você é cidadão do Brasil ou tem residência legal ou permissão para trabalhar no Brasil.
  • Consanguinidade: Você não tem familiares (até o quarto grau de consanguinidade e segundo grau de afinidade, incluindo cônjuge) trabalhando no BID, BID Invest ou BID Lab.

Type of contract and duration

  • Tipo de contrato: Consultor Nacional (modalidade Remota Local).
  • Duração: 12 meses.
  • Local de trabalho: Remoto.

Se consultor de Modalidade Remota Local: O candidato selecionado não prestará serviços a partir do escritório do Banco e não terá espaço físico nas instalações do escritório do Banco no país. O candidato selecionado será responsável pelo espaço, e por ter os equipamentos, internet e acessos telefônicos para o cumprimento destes TDRs, fora do escritório do Banco. O acesso aos sistemas do Banco será providenciado em coordenação com o Banco.

What we offer

  • O Grupo BID oferece benefícios que respondem às diferentes necessidades e momentos da vida de um funcionário, incluindo:
  • Remuneração competitiva
  • Licença e férias: 2 dias por mês de contrato + licença parental neutra em termos de gênero
  • Seguro de saúde: subsídio mensal para a compra de seguro

  • Horários de trabalho híbridos e flexíveis
  • Saúde e bem estar: acesso ao Centro de Serviços de Saúde
  • Apoio ao desenvolvimento: oportunidades de aprendizado, seminários e aconselhamento profissional 1:1

Our culture

No BID, trabalhamos para garantir que todos/as possam contribuir com o seu melhor e ser autênticos/as em seu trabalho, ao mesmo tempo em que encontram seu propósito. Nossa equipe busca constantemente a excelência e reconhecemos e celebramos o impacto de suas contribuições. title: Sdr Bilíngue (Sales Development Representative)
description:
Descrição

Buscamos um SDR Bilíngue (Sales Development Representative) dinâmico, proativo e especialista em prospecção B2B para integrar nosso time, focado no mercado dos Estados Unidos. Este profissional será a força motriz por trás da expansão do nosso projeto SaaS.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Configurar e otimizar campanhas de prospecção e conexão com leads dentro do nosso ICP (Ideal Customer Profile), utilizando ferramentas como LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dux, etc.
  • Identificar dores, desafios e oportunidades dos leads que possam ser solucionados pela nossa empresa, para personalizar a abordagem de vendas.
  • Realizar pesquisa e análise prévia do perfil da empresa a ser contatada, bem como dos decisores (decision-makers) que serão convidados para a demonstração.
  • Qualificar leads de forma estratégica, utilizando técnicas de pesquisa para garantir que apenas as oportunidades mais promissoras avancem no funil de vendas.

  • Realizar follow-ups constantes para nutrir o relacionamento com potenciais clientes, criando um cenário favorável para a conversão após a demonstração.
  • Manter o CRM (Hubspot) e outras planilhas internas meticulosamente atualizadas, registrando todas as interações e o progresso dos leads.
  • Gerir ativamente a agenda de demonstrações, incluindo marcação, confirmação e reagendamentos, atuando sempre com atenção e proatividade.
  • Colaborar com o time de vendas (Closers) para garantir que as reuniões agendadas sejam altamente produtivas, fornecendo todo o contexto necessário sobre o lead.
  • Cumprir rigorosamente os prazos e metas estabelecidos pela gestão.

Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente é importante e requisito, pois toda a comunicação (ligações, e-mails) será em inglês.
  • Cursando ou formado em Marketing, Administração, Comunicação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada em prospecção e cold calls.
  • Experiência prévia na qualificação de leads.
  • Experiência como SDR prospectando para produtos SaaS (Software as a Service) ou de tecnologia.
  • Boa capacidade de gerir múltiplas tarefas e cumprir prazos em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita na língua portuguesa e inglesa.
  • Bons conhecimentos de informática, como MS Office, softwares de CRM (Hubspot é um diferencial), redes sociais e agendas eletrônicas.
  • Experiência e desenvoltura em reuniões remotas via Teams, Google Meet, etc.

Diferenciais

  • Já ter atuado com segmentação e qualificação de leads em mercados como startups, empresas de tecnologia e marcas inovadoras.
  • Experiência com metodologias de vendas como SPIN Selling, MEDDIC, ou The Challenger Sale.
  • Conhecimento de PNL (Programação Neurolinguística) aplicada a vendas.
  • Cursos e certificações em Vendas, Inbound Marketing ou Customer Success.

Competências Importantes

  • Comunicação, habilidade em negociação, poder de persuasão e carisma.
  • Perfil empreendedor, resiliente e orientado para resultados.
  • Capacidade de contornar objeções e lidar com frustrações.
  • Ambição voltada para o crescimento profissional e financeiro.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, sob pressão e com metas.
  • Capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks de forma construtiva.

Informações sobre a Contratação

  • Contrato : PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)
  • Modelo de Trabalho : 100% Remoto (home office)
  • Remuneração : Fixo + Remuneração variável sobre reunião qualificada.

Requirements

  • Advanced skills in typography, layout, and visual storytelling with meticulous attention to detail

Why Join Us?

Work on beautiful, premium skincare brands where your creative decisions directly impact visibility and sales. Join a collaborative team that values thoughtful pushback, testing, and continuous learning—where you’re encouraged to teach, challenge assumptions, and help raise the bar on Amazon-first design.

title: Customer Success Specialist - Refunds & Escalations
description:
Position Overview:

ELVTR is a premier online education platform specializing in live courses led by top executives from globally renowned companies. Our unique approach sets us apart in the online education landscape, offering unparalleled value to our students. As we continue expanding, we seek a detail-oriented and proactive Customer Success Specialist with a focus on Refunds and Escalations to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will manage client retention, handle refunds and billing inquiries, and provide vital administrative support to our sales team.

This is a full-time remote position, open to candidates located in Brazil.

This job is for you if you are:

  • Confident and Assertive : You are fearless in handling demanding clients - can de-escalate situations quickly as well as handling the objections during the conversations with the students effectively.
  • A Problem Solver: You can efficiently resolve billing issues and overdue accounts, ensuring client satisfaction and retention.
  • Highly Organized: You have strong organizational skills and pay attention to detail, which is crucial for managing calendars and maintaining accurate records.
  • A Strong Communicator: You excel at phone and email communication and are capable of building strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Tech-Savvy: You are experienced with CRM systems and can easily navigate various business tools.

Responsibilities:

  • Handle refunds and transfer requests on a day-to-day basis, providing an excellent experience to customers and retaining a high percentage of saved students.
  • Engage with customers to resolve concerns, improve satisfaction, and encourage loyalty.
  • Handle chargeback cases promptly, providing necessary documentation and resolutions.
  • Actively work in the CRM to keep track of cases and maintain the Refunds Report and Monthly KPI report to improve refund-related processes.
  • Regularly review and address missing tickets to ensure no unresolved customer inquiries.
  • Attend weekly production meetings with Program Managers and Instructional Designers to address concerns and align on strategies.
  • Handle customer complaints effectively, ensuring swift resolutions and capturing insights to prevent recurrence.
  • Manage the Welcome Back Credits process for re-engaging former customers.
  • Hold monthly cross-functional meetings to assess the general picture, identify patterns, and propose process improvements.
  • Assist with additional operational tasks as needed, ensuring smooth workflows and team efficiency.
  • Improve internal processes and offer solutions.

Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience in sales, customer success, or customer service, with a focus on handling sensitive client requests such as cancellations, refunds, or account adjustments
  • Familiarity with CRM systems
  • Excellent phone and email communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Strong organizational skills and keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive problem-solver with a customer-focused mindset.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills to assess patterns and propose actionable solutions.
  • High level of adaptability and willingness to take on diverse responsibilities.
  • Competitive Salary and Bonuses: We value your dedication and expertise, offering a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Exciting Benefits: Enjoy gym membership reimbursements, mental health benefits, generous vacation allowance, and free access to all our courses. We believe in continuous learning, both for our customers and our team.
  • Remote Work: The freedom to work remotely, crafting a work-life balance that fits your personal needs.
  • Collaborative Work Environment: Join a team of passionate, like-minded individuals. At ELVTR, collaboration isn't just a buzzword; it's how we grow, innovate, and excel together.

Why You Should Join ELVTR:

  • Innovative and Positive Culture: Join a team of passionate individuals driven by a common vision.
  • Growth Opportunities: At ELVTR, we believe in nurturing talent and providing abundant opportunities for professional development.
  • A Mission You Can Be Proud of: Be part of a brand that stands for quality, innovation, and inspiring education. Be part of a company that’s changing the face of online education, connecting students with top-tier executives.

Join Us:

If you have the skills and dedication to excel in this role, we invite you to apply. Your ability to manage client relationships and handle billing issues efficiently will make you an invaluable asset to our team.

Due to the high volume of applications, we will only be able to respond to candidates with whom we are interested in proceeding. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to reviewing your application.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive professional to manage the full order-to-revenue cycle — from deal structuring and validation to order processing, delivery coordination, invoicing readiness, and revenue forecasting. This role serves as a key liaison between Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to ensure accuracy, compliance, and efficiency across all commercial operations, with a strong focus on adherence to IFRS 15 revenue recognition principles.

Deal Review & Structuring

  • Advise Sales on deal structures, acceptance criteria, and contractual terms that impact bookings and revenue recognition.

  • Review and process customer Purchase Orders (POs) in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.
  • Coordinate with Supply Chain/Logistics for hardware and appliance deliveries, and manage software e-delivery notifications.
  • Process internal/demo sales orders and ensure all orders are properly documented in ERP/CRM systems.

Revenue Forecasting & Tracking

  • Maintain and update the Revenue Schedule at the start of each quarter and on a weekly basis to reflect deal changes.
  • Consolidate input from Sales, Professional Services, Finance, and Supply Chain to support accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Track project completion, acceptance milestones, and payment status to ensure timely revenue recognition.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting

  • Lead or participate in weekly meetings to track deal progress, delivery timelines, technical issues, and payment updates.
  • Work closely with Credit Management on credit checks and customer credit status.
  • Support RFP reviews with financial and operational input.
  • Maintain trackers and reports (e.g., Order Management Tracker, Bookings Tie-Up Report) to ensure visibility on order and revenue status.

Skills & Requirements

  • Experience: 2+ years in revenue operations, order management, sales operations, deal desk, or similar roles.
  • Systems: Proficiency in Salesforce, CPQ, ERP systems (Oracle/SAP), and Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas).
  • Knowledge: Understanding of revenue recognition principles (IFRS 15), quote-to-cash processes, and sales lifecycle operations.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong attention to detail and ability to assess revenue and operational impacts.
  • Communication: Clear and professional communication skills for effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Organization: Strong ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Deep knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Platform.

Proficiency with Salesforce Lightning, APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
Job Summary
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
As an SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.
Location : This role is available remotely in any timezone.
As a Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer engineer you will

  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Develop new features and improve the resilience and scalability of the existing cloud and container portfolio at Canonical
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Collaborate with development teams to design service architecture, documentation, playbooks, policies and operational procedures
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations
What we are looking for in you
  • A deep experience of, and knowledge to define operations in code, using version control, peer review and CI/CD to roll out changes both to applications and infrastructure
  • Strong modern engineering background (peer-review, unit testing, SCM, CI/CD, Agile)
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  14. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including solution designs, architectural diagrams, and coding guidelines. Contribute regularly to support the scalability of our rapid growth.

  16. Provide training to development teams and end-users, ensuring they are well-equipped to effectively use and maintain Salesforce applications.

  • Experience in Agile methodologies and project management practices.
  • Experience leading large-scale Salesforce implementations and managing teams.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

  2. Profile review : Our team will review your profile and keep it in our talent database.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We've raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth. We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain's growing Security team. This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain's application and platform security posture. This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container/Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vuln, credential stuffing, web/API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring, etc.).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain's architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English, including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
  • Proven expertise in performing code review or security assessments and writing clear reports.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js) and understanding of React/React Native front-ends.
  • Familiarity with secure architecture of microservices, event-driven systems, and REST APIs using OAuth2/OpenID Connect.
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and integrating AppSec tooling into SDLC.
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals.
  • Understanding of cloud security (preferably AWS), including IAM principles, cloud-native service configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Comfortable with Agile development methodologies and working within cross-functional squads.
  • Software supply chain security (e.g., SBOM, artifact signing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CPTE, or CSSLP.
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure Security Specialty certification.
  • Familiarity with bug bounty triage and vulnerability management platforms (e.g., DefectDojo).
  • Experience implementing RASP or eBPF runtime protection tools.
  • Exposure to LLM/AI security considerations and secure code generation practices.
  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).

What we offer:

About Innodata

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a global leader in data engineering and AI-powered solutions, partnering with 4 of the top 5 global technology companies and serving over 2,000 enterprise clients worldwide. With operations in 13 global locations and a workforce of 5,000+ subject matter experts, we are at the forefront of innovation in machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and large language model (LLM) training.

By combining deep domain expertise, advanced AI / ML technologies, and secure infrastructure, Innodata is shaping the future of AI systems and making them smarter, safer, and more contextually aware.

About the Role

We are seeking a Psychology Subject Matter Expert (SME) with exceptional analytical, writing, and research skills to join our AI / LLM training team. You will play a key role in developing, curating, and evaluating psychology-related content to train AI models in psychological concepts, theories, and applied practices. This role is ideal for psychologists, researchers, educators, and mental health professionals passionate about leveraging their expertise to enhance AI’s understanding of psychology and human behavior.

Responsibilities

  • Content Development
    • Create high-quality psychology content, including:
    • Theoretical explanations of psychological frameworks and concepts.
    • Research-based case studies, assessments, and intervention examples.
    • Summaries of key psychological theories, studies, and experiments.
    • Content across major domains: Cognitive Psychology; Developmental Psychology; Clinical & Counseling Psychology; Social Psychology; Behavioral and Neuropsychology; Industrial-Organizational Psychology; Psychometrics and Psychological Testing.
  • Model Evaluation & AI Training
    • Review and refine AI-generated psychology content for accuracy, clarity, and sensitivity.
    • Identify and correct conceptual errors, cultural biases, and ethical concerns.
    • Design rubrics and evaluation criteria for AI model reasoning in psychological contexts.
  • Research & Collaboration
    • Collaborate with AI researchers, computational linguists, and engineers to improve AI reasoning in psychology.
    • Provide expert input for datasets covering mental health, psychological assessment, and therapy practices.
    • Support ethical and culturally sensitive approaches to psychological topics in AI models.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Master’s or PhD in Psychology or a closely related discipline (PhD preferred).
  • Strong academic and / or applied experience in one or more areas: Clinical, Counseling, or Health Psychology; Developmental or Educational Psychology; Cognitive or Behavioral Sciences; Psychometrics and Research Methods.
  • Demonstrated expertise in academic writing, research, or content development.
  • Ability to synthesize complex theories and present them clearly for diverse audiences.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with AI / ML concepts, NLP, or data annotation (a plus).
  • Understanding of mental health ethics, confidentiality, and cultural competence.
  • Experience with psychological assessments, surveys, and statistical tools.

Why Join Innodata?

  • Help shape how AI models understand human behavior and mental health.
  • Work with global teams of researchers, linguists, and engineers.
  • Contribute to next-generation AI technologies that promote psychological insights.
  • Enjoy a remote-first, flexible work environment and research-driven culture.

Additional Information

  • Candidates must complete an English Language Assessment.
  • Mandatory and non-billable step.

title: Clinical Specialist, CAS (VA & DC)
description:
Overview

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on 26 Sep 2025.

At Medtronic you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world.

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, your work has a direct and lasting impact on patients, families, and the future of medicine. As a Clinical Specialist in Cardiac Ablation Solutions , you're not just supporting procedures—you’re enabling groundbreaking therapies that can help patients reclaim their lives from complex arrhythmias.

This role includes a pathway to become a Mapping Specialist through a structured training program. Experienced clinical professionals joining as Clinical Specialists will gain deep expertise in mapping systems and complex ablation procedures, positioning them as advanced clinical leaders in the field. This is an ideal opportunity to expand your clinical impact and grow within Medtronic\'s Cardiac Ablation Solutions team.

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. This is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site; the candidate hired will reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver\'s license is essential for this role.

This position posting is location flexible and can be based in any of the following locations (DC or VA).

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide technical, educational, clinical and sales support to assist the Region in meeting Cardiac Ablation Solutions sales and customer service objectives.
  • Represent Medtronic CAS during ablation procedures to provide troubleshooting and other technical assistance.
  • Receive technical inquiries from customers. Research solutions to questions or problems (e.g., Catheter, Console, Generator support).
  • Educate and train physicians, hospital personnel and office staff on technical matters relating to AFS products and related procedures.
  • Assist RM and field training department in educating/training new Clinical Specialists and Account Managers.
  • Provide training and resources for hospital staff to enable them to conduct training for their personnel.
  • Provide sales support to help influence revenue growth within the region.
  • Update sales representatives concerning procedures. Immediately notify Account Manager regarding issues or problems requiring follow-up.
  • Serve as an effective Medtronic CAS representative to physicians and support staff regarding Medtronic CAS products, service and support.
  • Promote the safe and effective use of Medtronic CAS products and related procedures.
  • Understand national, regional and territory sales objectives. Work in partnership with Account Manager to achieve and exceed goals.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work, but they are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and skills for this position.

Must Have Minimum Requirements

To be considered for this role, please ensure these minimum requirements are evident on your resume.

  • High School diploma PLUS a minimum 6 years of work experience in healthcare within an EP, Cath Lab setting or sales in cardiac field.
  • OR Associate degree PLUS a minimum of 4 years of work experience in healthcare within an EP, Cath Lab setting or sales in cardiac field.
  • OR Bachelor degree PLUS a minimum 2 years work experience in healthcare within an EP, Cath Lab setting or sales in cardiac field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preference will be given to local qualified candidates and candidates with Medtronic experience.
  • B.A./B.S. Degree in nursing, cardiovascular, life sciences, or technical discipline with minimum of four years\' work experience in cardiac field, hospital/clinic or sales.
  • Pacing school/ATI-like training program in addition to BQs.
  • Proven track record with technical training assignments.
  • Experience in the cardiac catheter ablation field, EP lab, in a hospital/clinic or EP medical sales providing technical/clinical support.

Additional Job Requirements

  • Environmental exposure to infectious disease and radiation.
  • Clinical Specialists are required to be within their assigned territory each day to be available for unscheduled needs.
  • Clinical Specialists will on occasion be required to travel outside of their assigned territory and may require overnight travel.
  • Must have a valid driver\'s license.
  • Ability to move around the facility, use a phone, keyboard and mouse, and interact with personal computers.
  • Must be able to stand/sit/walk for 8 hours a day.
  • Must be able to drive approximately 75% of the time within assigned territory and may require overnight travel.
  • Driver\'s license and active vehicle insurance policy; driving record will be reviewed as part of the application.

CARDIOVASCULAR PORTFOLIO:
Cardiac Ablation Solutions offers cardiac mapping and ablation solutions to treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms. Our vision is to help patients worldwide by advancing innovation for the diagnosis and ablation of cardiac arrhythmias, enabling clinicians to perform procedures with superior outcomes.

Physical Job Requirements

The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met to perform the essential functions. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. For Office Roles: the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile, interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers.

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package. Salary ranges for U.S. locations (excl. PR) are $90,000.00 - $100,000.00. The base salary range is applicable across the United States, excluding Puerto Rico and certain California locations. The offered rate complies with regulations and may vary based on experience, certification/education, market conditions, and location. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurance, HSA/HC Spending Accounts, life insurance, disability leave, dependent care spending, tuition assistance, and well-being programs.

The following benefits are available to regular employees who work 20+ hours per week: Incentive plans, 401(k) with employer contribution and match, Short-term disability, Paid time off, Paid holidays, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Employee Assistance Program, and other retirement-related plans. Some benefits may not apply to workers in Puerto Rico.

Further details are available at the link below: Medtronic benefits and compensation plans.

We lead global healthcare technology and boldly attack the most challenging health problems facing humanity by searching out and finding solutions. Our Mission is to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. We are engineers at heart—putting ambitious ideas to work to generate real solutions. Learn more about our business, mission, and our commitment to diversity here.

title: 10X FullStack Engineer
description:
10x Engineer

SFR3 is a boutique real estate investment fund managing $2B+ of affordable single-family homes. The Fund renovates distressed homes, using software-driven operations to run many “tertiary” markets concurrently. Today we own 10,500+ homes in 20 states.

You

You love building software that directly enables your team to crack critical business challenges. You’ve shipped production applications and can strike the right balance between shipping fast for immediate impact and long-term vision. You enjoy working remotely along with the independence and responsibility that comes with that.

Real estate is the world’s largest asset class, but experience in the domain is not required. What is necessary is motivation to dive in and understand the work people do every day so you can build the right tools that give them leverage. The idea of building & running a $150M/yr business that operates like a startup, growing at 5-7%/yr (not a startup looking for PMF) is exciting to you.

What You’ll Do

Buying, renovating, and managing a portfolio of thousands of homes worth billions of dollars is a big task. Our team is continuously experimenting to improve efficiency and accelerate operations.

You’ll join a pod that consists of seasoned business owners paired with product and have complete ownership over a domain to to crank out needle moving features weekly. There’s a lot for a small team to do, so we look for “T-shaped” engineers. You should be comfortable and confident across any stack, but also have deep expertise in one or more areas where you can be the team expert.

To manage single-family rentals at our scale, we write lots of software that runs our operations. For this dev pod, our users are hundreds of employees and vendors located in 40+ markets who renovate homes, repair issues for residents, and prepare our vacant homes for the next move-in.

In this role, you will:

  • Leverage cutting-edge AI to accelerate development. You’ll experiment with and adopt modern AI tools—like large language models, code-generation platforms, and automation frameworks—to rapidly prototype features, streamline workflows, and continuously innovate. This culture of experimentation and speed ensures we stay ahead of the curve and deliver high-impact products faster.
  • Design and develop backend systems that power our field and property management operations. You'll build robust and scalable services that integrate with both our in house developed solution and external SaaS whether it be a reliable ledger or AI driven resource optimization models.
  • Integrate with third-party APIs (REST, GraphQL, etc.) to enhance our platforms and ensure seamless communication between different services.
  • Collaborate on scoping and prioritizing the roadmap. We constantly ship and evaluate new problems and opportunities to improve workflows. You’ll regularly interact with users, ship fast, and help define our long-term tech vision—making trade-offs between effort and impact to focus on the most critical work.
  • Analyze system efficiency and performance. We’re committed to continuous improvement and optimization. You’ll use data to monitor software performance and identify opportunities that drive business results and enhance system reliability.

Your Stats

You'll be working across multiple backend projects. You might be a great fit if these attributes describe you:

  • Experience building backend systems that drive real-world processes and results.
  • Strong expertise in Python; React, Java and Ruby on Rails knowledge is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming.
  • Deep knowledge of AWS and cloud-based services.
  • Understanding the benefits and tradeoffs of different databases and their setups including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and DynamoDB.
  • Strong product sensibilities to build experiences users love.
  • AI-first sensibilities.
  • Entrepreneurial experience preferred.

Working timezone overlaps at least 5 working hours with US Pacific Time.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Llm / Ai-Enabled Systems
description:
About Health Note

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid, disconnected software modules, our assistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural, empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience for every patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.

About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely and reliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empathetic experience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfully incorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at the frontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronous communication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack TypeScript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture is service oriented and managed in a Monorepo.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant services and applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention to safety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for other engineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring, automated testing, CI / CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for our products, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards and architectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled product experiences that meet real client needs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications, databases, and developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintaining production applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript / TypeScript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), and PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (HTTP2, WebSockets, gRPC, GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significant impact.
  • Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it through automated testing, CI / CD, and observability.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.g., measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
  • Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse, Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Cloudwatch, etc.).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Familiarity with internal UI and integration tools (ReTool, Salesforce Communities, Contentful, NextJS, etc.).
  • Experience with containers and orchestrators like Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Background in healthcare, regulated industries, or EHR / EMR integration.
  • Experience debugging distributed systems.
  • You do not need to have prior experience with every technology in our stack. We believe great candidates are capable of learning new tools quickly, and we provide mentorship and guidance as needed.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health / Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Overview

About Health Note

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid,disconnected software modules, ourassistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural,empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience forevery patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.

About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital

assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely andreliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empatheticexperience that patients and providers trust.

You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfullyincorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at thefrontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds,GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture isservice oriented and managed in a Monorepo.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant servicesand applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention tosafety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for otherengineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring,automated testing, CI / CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for ourproducts, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards andarchitectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled productexperiences that meet real client needs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications,databases, and developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.g., OpenAI,Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintainingproduction applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with Javascript / Typescript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), andPostgresQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (HTTP2, WebSockets, gRPC,GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significantimpact.
  • Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it throughautomated testing, CI / CD, and observability.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.g.,measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
  • Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse,Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Cloudwatch, etc.).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Familiarity with internal UI and integration tools (ReTool, SalesforceCommunities, Contentful, NextJS, etc.).
  • Experience with containers and orchestrators like Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Background in healthcare, regulated industries, or EHR / EMR integration.
  • Experience debugging distributed systems.

    • You do not need to have prior experience with every technology in our stack. We believe great candidates are capable of learning new tools quickly, and weprovide mentorship and guidance as needed.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health / Sport Budget.

title: Especialista De Infraestrutura De Plataformas
description:

Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. Cost Management: Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms. Enhancing Observability: Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team. Collaboration and Support: Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team. Required Skills and Qualifications: Kubernetes Mastery: Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments. Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise: Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. Familiarity with each environment's unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively. Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential. Cost Optimization & Resource Management: Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. Proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures. Programming and Automation: Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.G., Bash, Python). Monitoring and Observability: Deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. Ability to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance. Problem-Solving Mindset: Thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential. Collaboration and Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals. Benefits: Experience the satisfaction of building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. Gain expertise in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers. Participate in shaping the future of our platform through innovative solutions and methodologies.

Realizar entrevistas, escutas ativas e visitas técnicas para identificar trabalhadores com deficiência, mesmo que ainda não formalmente declarados. Atuar em conjunto com as equipes de obra, RH e medicina do trabalho para propor adaptações de postos de trabalho. Desenvolver e aplicar estratégias de sensibilização e inclusão nos canteiros (palestras, DDS, cartilhas, campanhas). Monitorar a efetividade da inclusão dos PCDs nos projetos (acompanhar adaptação, desempenho, acolhimento). Garantir cumprimento das normas legais relacionadas à saúde do trabalhador e à inclusão de pessoas com deficiência (Lei de Cotas, NR-7, NR-17, entre outras). Acompanhar e controlar os prestadores de serviços de saúde ocupacional (clínicas), garantindo que realizem os exames em conformidade com PCMSO vigente. Experiência com saúde ocupacional e inclusão de PCDs será diferencial. Conhecimento básico sobre classificações de deficiência e barreiras de acessibilidade. title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment. ⸻ Core Responsibilities - Financial Control & Compliance - Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms. - Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations. - Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies. - Reporting & Deliverables - Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts. - Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. - Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability. - Prepare and monitor hedge calculations, manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs. - Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness. - Collaboration & Insights - Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities. - Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules. - Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs. - Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives. - Business Development & Bids - Support the analysis of new bids and tenders, with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility. - Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects. ⸻ Key Qualifications - Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries. - Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering. - Technical Skills: - Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge. - Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.
- Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.
- Soft Skills: - Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams. - Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality. - Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.
